about: Sonny Ellen Bail Bonds is at 110 N Washington Ave in Bryan.
It was founded in 1970 by Sonny Ellen and describes itself as the oldest professional bail bond company in Texas, with certified agents and an office open 24/7, closed only on Easter and Christmas.
Customers have given it 4.7 stars across 27 Google reviews.
